name: wizhex
description: WIZHEX - full-stack MERN marketplace for game accounts

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
